Corollary
[integrated scalar-curvature Harnack estimate] Source: cao-zhu 1. Corollary 2.5.7\group Cao–Zhu Li-Yau-Hamilton Estimates Let $g_{ij}(x,t)$ be a complete solution of the Ricci flow on a manifold with bounded and nonnegative curvature operator, and let $x_1,x_2\in M,\ 0<t_1<t_2.$ Then the following inequality holds \[ R(x_2,t_2)\geq \frac{t_1}{t_2}e^{-d_{t_1}(x_1,x_2)^2/2(t_2-t_1)}\cdot R(x_1,t_1). \]
